title: Carbon-chain Chemistry versus Complex-organic-molecule Chemistry in Envelopes around Three Low-mass Young Stellar Objects in the Perseus Region
question: Spatial distributions and CH3OH/HC3N abundance ratios in three Perseus low-mass YSOs, compared with Nautilus chemical models to test WCCC vs hot-corino-like chemistry

data.sensitivity: Continuum noise 4 mJy/beam (IRAS 03235, IRAS 03245) and 1 mJy/beam (IRAS 03271)

recipe.goal: Image line cubes from calibrated visibilities
recipe.method: tclean on pipeline-calibrated visibilities with uniform weighting

recipe.goal: Make continuum images and measure noise
recipe.method: Continuum (2 mm) images created from the data cubes using IMCONTSUB

recipe.goal: Moment 0 maps and 2D Gaussian fits for sizes and peak positions
recipe.method: 2D Gaussian fitting to continuum and moment 0 maps; beam-deconvolved sizes, with the synthesized beam given as upper limit when deconvolution fails
key_parameters: CH3OH moment 0 map made from the 1_0-1_-1 and 3_0-3_-1 lines because they are partially blended
assumptions: Distance 293 pc used to convert angular sizes to au

recipe.goal: Derive column densities and excitation temperatures from spectra
recipe.method: Optically thin LTE model in the CASSIS spectrum analyzer, fitted with MCMC to spectra at the HC3N emission peak
key_parameters: Case 1: Tex of HC3N and CH3OH restricted to 15-30 K
Case 2: Tex 35-40 K (IRAS 03235, IRAS 03245) and 35-50 K (IRAS 03271), comparable to dust temperatures

recipe.goal: Run chemical network models of the CH3OH/HC3N ratio
recipe.method: Nautilus hot-core model with a slow warm-up stage, varying cosmic-ray ionization rate and C/O ratio
key_parameters: Initial T 10 K rising to 200 K during warm-up
assumptions: Dust temperature equal to gas temperature

recipe.goal: Compare observed ratios with models to constrain age and temperature
recipe.method: Observed CH3OH/HC3N ratios (with errors, Cases 1 and 2) overplotted on model ratio vs time; ages after the temperature reaches 25 K compared; model temperature checked against observed dust temperature
key_parameters: For non-detections, ratio assumed lower than the IRAS 03245 value
assumptions: Dust temperature of IRAS 03235 expected to be similar to the other two sources
